cross_cutting_findings.finding: Conversation memory evolved toward bounded recursive abstraction with provenance-preserving retrieval surfaces; UnifiedDB must preserve source-message lineage when pruning/compressing projections.

Reality grounding is surface-conditioned: injecting authoritative raw reality into every cognitive path can itself create prompt leakage. Ground truth should project through task-specific bounded views rather than universal raw blocks.

Installer, updater, recovery binary, documentation and live runtime repeatedly drifted apart. Acceptance must compare all release/recovery manifests against the instantiated capability graph, ports, dependencies and persistent schemas.

Historical metrics can later be epistemically downgraded by the source lineage itself. Level-0 must preserve supersession/retraction edges and never keep an earlier stronger claim after a later correction without qualification.

Large deep-audit history supplies a regression atlas, but source-reported bug/fix counts are not equivalent to reproduced current failures. Harness should encode mechanism classes, not import counts as truth.
Supervisor semantics must be portable across systemd and container process-manager substrates; liveness/recovery contracts belong above the deployment substrate.

anti_double_counting.rule: Material mechanisms overlap existing LCME/context, prompt contamination/reality, boot/recovery, state persistence and failure-regression mappings. This shard closes history semantics only.
